content: tailscale.com/client/tailscale.LocalClient.WhoIs(ctx context.Context, remoteAddr string) (*apitype.WhoIsResponse, error). WhoIsResponse has Node (*tailcfg.Node with Name, Hostinfo) and UserProfile (*tailcfg.UserProfile with LoginName, DisplayName) — both never nil on success. Use r.RemoteAddr on incoming HTTP/WebSocket connections. Module tailscale.com v1.98.3 already in go.mod.
